Fixed all TypeScript build errors in commit `0c3236b` and `59ba8dc`:

1. **`DashboardRenderer.tsx:203,244`** — Added `filter?: any` to `isObjectProvider` type guard return type in `utils.ts`
2. **`DashboardRenderer.tsx:204-205,217-218`** — Added `searchable?: boolean` and `pagination?: boolean` to `DashboardWidgetSchema` in `types/complex.ts`
3. **`WidgetConfigPanel.tsx:523-524`** — Annotated `normalizedConfig` as `Record<string, any>` to preserve the index signature (TS drops it when spreading `Record<string, any>` with explicit properties)
4. **`ObjectGrid.tsx:623`** — Extracted `resolveColumnLabel()` helper to properly resolve `I18nLabel | string` from `ListColumn.label` to a plain string, using the `I18nLabel` type from `@objectstack/spec/ui`

Optimized the Vercel build in `d744723` — the `buildCommand` now inlines only the steps needed for the static SPA deployment:

```
pnpm msw:init && VITE_BASE_PATH=/ VITE_USE_MOCK_SERVER=true vite build
```

This skips two steps that were wasting ~3-7 minutes:
- **`tsc`** — console's tsconfig has `noEmit: true` (type-check only, no output)
- **`build:plugin`** — compiles the server-side `plugin.ts` which isn't used in Vercel's static deployment

If the build still times out, **Enhanced Builds** needs to be enabled in the Vercel dashboard (Project Settings → General) — it provides a larger machine with more CPUs and memory. That's a Vercel project setting that can't be configured from code.

Added `--concurrency=3` and `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096` to the turbo step in `2dd45fd`. The turbo phase builds 30+ workspace packages, of which 20+ use `vite build`. Without concurrency limits, turbo spawns ~10 Vite processes simultaneously on Vercel's 8GB machine, causing OOM or extreme memory pressure that pushes past 45 minutes. With `--concurrency=3`, only 3 builds run in parallel (~3-4.5GB peak), staying within memory limits while completing in ~10-20 minutes.

If the build still times out, **Enhanced Builds** must be enabled in the Vercel dashboard (Project Settings → General) — it provides a larger machine (24GB RAM, more CPUs) that can't be configured from code.

Fixed in `7f9bb2c` — the `effectiveRelated` variable was inferred as a discriminated union because the fallback `discoveredRelated.map()` branch returns objects without `api`/`columns` properties. Annotated it as `NonNullable<DetailViewSchema['related']>` so both branches share the same type shape and `related.api`/`related.columns` resolve correctly.

> @copilot 13:18:40.411 [31m[commonjs--resolver] Failed to resolve entry for package "@object-ui/react". The package may have incorrect main/module/exports specified in its package.json: No known condi...

Fixed in `e1b90d2` — 9 workspace packages (`@object-ui/react`, `core`, `auth`, `collaboration`, `i18n`, `mobile`, `permissions`, `tenant`, and `cli`) only had `types` + `import` conditions in their `package.json` exports. Rollup's `commonjs--resolver` doesn't recognize `import`, so it failed with "No known conditions". Added `"default": "./dist/index.js"` as a catch-all condition to all of them.

Fixed in `0eedfe7` — restored src/ aliases for ALL environments (dev + CI). The dist/-based resolution caused the `ComponentRegistry` singleton to get duplicated across Rollup chunks, so plugin `register()` calls went to a different instance than the one `SchemaRenderer` queries.

The turbo build step is now removed from the Vercel buildCommand since Vite processes sources directly via aliases. Memory savings are still achieved by skipping compression/visualizer plugins in CI (~1.5 GB reduction).
